subject: Request: Technical Handoff — Inference Runtime Validation Lab
messages:
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Park <jordan.park@luminoai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 16:02:00 +0000
Subject: Request: Technical Handoff — Inference Runtime Validation Lab

Hi Jordan —

Great to meet you in the discovery last week. As discussed, the best next step is a hands-on validation lab so your engineering team can see Redwood serving a representative inference workload and we can validate network/KV cache behavior against your expected request mix.

Proposed agenda (60–75 min):
- 10m — Intros & goals (you + Redwood engineering leads)
- 20m — Live run: inference perf/latency under sample load (we’ll use a trimmed test corpus you sent)
- 15m — Deep-dive: network paths, prefix/KV cache behavior, and fallback policy
- 10–20m — Q&A and next steps / MJAs

Please confirm:
- Attendees (we recommend your infra lead + one application engineer)
- Any blocked ports or strict NATs we should know about (we'll share a short network_requirements.pdf)
- Your preferred time windows next week (we're mostly flexible mornings PST)

Options we have available:
- Tue 2026-11-30 16:00–17:15 UTC
- Wed 2026-12-01 15:00–16:15 UTC
- Thu 2026-12-02 09:00–10:15 UTC

I’ve copied Marissa (pre-sales engineering) and Ben (solutions) so we can coordinate the runbook and invite list.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this scheduled.

—
Evelyn Hart
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
(e) evelyn_hart@redwoodinference.com | (m) +1 (415) 555-0198
Redwood Inference — production-first LLM serving

Attachment: network_requirements.pdf (stub — details on ports, TLS, and temporary service accounts)

From: Jordan Park <jordan.park@luminoai.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: eng-admin@luminoai.com
Date: Thu, 26 Nov 2026 09:41:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Request: Technical Handoff — Inference Runtime Validation Lab

Thanks Evelyn — this looks good.

Quick notes from our side:
- We’ll have our infra lead (Priya Mehta) and app owner (Sam Cho) attend.
- We do have a corporate proxy for outbound connections; I attached our internal network checklist to make sure nothing surprises us.
- Of the proposed slots, Thu 2026-12-02 09:00–10:15 UTC is best for our team. Would you be able to start at 09:00 UTC sharp? Our Eastern team has a hard cut at 10:30 local.

Also: we need to confirm whether Redwood will need any long-lived credentials in our environment or if a short-lived service token is sufficient. If you have a one-page runbook/example token flow that would be ideal.

Jordan
Jordan Park
Director of Platform Engineering — LuminoAI
jordan.park@luminoai.com | +1 (650) 555-4432

Attachment: lumino_network_checklist.pdf (internal)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Park <jordan.park@luminoai.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 10:12:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Request: Technical Handoff — Inference Runtime Validation Lab

Jordan — thanks for the quick reply and the checklist. Thu 2026-12-02 09:00–10:15 UTC works for us; we’ll plan to start at 09:00 UTC sharp.

Action items from Redwood before the lab:
- We will send a short runbook (inference_runbook_v1.pdf) with token flow examples for short-lived credentials and a minimal set of IAM scopes.
- Ben will prepare a lightweight load generator and a trimmed prompt set matching the discovery profile.
- Karthik will lead the deep-dive on KV cache behavior and graceful fallback logic.

Please share Priya and Sam’s calendar addresses so we can send a calendar invite with a Google Meet link and the runbook. Also, if you have a staging tenant or a sample dataset that reproduces any of the corner cases you mentioned, please drop a Drive link.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-Lumino-Runbook
HubSpot: hubspot:contacts/6721

Thanks — Marissa

Attendees from Redwood: Karthik (lead), Marissa (runbook/ops), Ben (load/generator), Evelyn (customer liaison).

Prep notes: please ensure the staging tenant has a reduced token limit for the run and that any IP allowlists include our temporary test egress IPs (listed in network_requirements.pdf). If you want a 30-min pre-call to validate connectivity and tokens, we can do Wed 2026-12-01 15:30–16:00 UTC. Reply if you want that slot — otherwise we’ll assume all good and run the lab on Thursday.
